headline: X product chief Nikita Bier is leaving after one year
summary: X head of product Nikita Bier is stepping down after one year. He will transition into an advisory role at the company. Bier announced his departure, stating it's time to "pass the torch."

headline: Two of Ring’s latest video doorbells are a lot cheaper than usual
summary: Ring's Wired Doorbell Pro and Battery Doorbell Plus are currently on sale. The Wired Doorbell Pro is $50 off at $199 via Amazon and Best Buy. The Battery Doorbell Plus is also discounted for a limited time.

headline: Uber CEO brushes off reports of a Waymo break-up
summary: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi denies reports of a fraying partnership with Waymo. He confirms the companies are committed to working together in Atlanta and Austin. Khosrowshahi stated the partnership remains "very strong."

headline: Apple’s selling refurbished MacBook Neos with a $100 discount
summary: Apple is offering refurbished MacBook Neo laptops with a $100 discount. The base 256GB model is now $599, down from its usual $699 new price. All four colors are available refurbished directly from Apple.

headline: PlayStation 5 Consoles Now Come With Warning Sticker Telling Players That Physical Game Production Will End
summary: Sony is reportedly placing advisory stickers on new PlayStation 5 consoles. These stickers warn players that physical game production will soon be discontinued. The move has sparked significant backlash within the gaming community.

headline: GTA 5 Actor Auditioned for 60 Roles in GTA 6, But Heard Nothing from Rockstar
summary: Robert Bogue, who played Steve Haines in GTA 5, auditioned for 60 roles in GTA 6. Despite numerous attempts, he received no feedback from Rockstar Games. This highlights the secretive nature of major game development.

headline: This K-Pop Star Looks Just Like Ada Wong and Her Fanbase Can't Unsee the Resemblance
summary: K-Pop star Asa of BABYMONSTER is being compared to Resident Evil’s Ada Wong. Fans noticed a striking resemblance in her recent selfies due to her outfit and hairstyle. The comparison quickly went viral among her fanbase.

headline: Minecraft Is Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Soon With an Upgrade Path for Switch 1 Owners
summary: Minecraft is set to receive a dedicated version for the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2. Current Nintendo Switch 1 owners will be eligible for a free upgrade path. This ensures an enhanced experience for existing players on new hardware.

headline: Infantino vows to fight on as Fifa president after executive meeting
summary: Gianni Infantino will remain as Fifa president, backed by senior executives. He issued a "sincere apology" for errors in his controversial private investment plans. Infantino declared his intention to continue leading the organization.

headline: Ex neo-Nazi activist withdraws as Tory election candidate
summary: Joshua Bonehill-Paine, a former neo-Nazi activist, has withdrawn as a Tory election candidate. Kemi Badenoch announced he will now advise the Conservatives. His new role focuses on tackling extremism.

headline: Woman arrested after four stabbed in central London
summary: Four men were stabbed in central London in an overnight incident. Metropolitan Police confirmed a woman has been arrested in connection with the stabbings. Investigations into the precise circumstances are ongoing.

headline: University of Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism row resigns
summary: Professor Jason Arday of the University of Cambridge has resigned from his position. His resignation follows a significant plagiarism controversy. Arday stated he concluded it was the "only way to bring this chapter to an end."
